primitives.name: Murray QB Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Kyler Murray, QB — $7,200 (triple-confirmed: FantasyLabs, FantasyAlarm, thehuddle) - Projection: low-end QB1 / ranked QB15 (thehuddle).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_P_FD_QB': 'Expected FanDuel fantasy points per game, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Triple confirmation from FantasyLabs, FantasyAlarm, and thehuddle implies high signal-to-noise ratio. Murray's Week 1 QB1 ranking is tempered by his history of four different Week 1 starters in four years, suggesting a high variance baseline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapse risk: Murray's 2025 foot injury and IR stint introduces a 20-25% probability of performance deterioration relative to his Arizona peak.

layer2.mapping: Maps Murray's QB projection to a GSI conformal prediction interval centered on his QB15 rank, accounting for his elevated volatility compared to established vets. The GSE mapping treats his starter history as a state-transition hazard.
layer2.telemetry: Track Murray's completion percentage, yards per attempt, and touchdown-to-interception ratio against Green Bay's suspect secondary metrics (FantasyPros defensive rankings)

primitives.name: Jefferson WR Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Justin Jefferson, WR — $8,100 (single source: thehuddle; DK $7,300) - Projection: consensus WR10 (USA Today), WR2 (FantasyPros primer); +165 anytime TD.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_ATTD_Jefferson': 'Probability of Justin Jefferson scoring an anytime touchdown, dimensionless', 'beta': 'Logistic slope parameter, 1/dollar', 'x': 'Jefferson salary relative to WR average, dimensionless', 'x_0': 'Inflection point salary differential, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Thehuddle's projection implicitly embeds a logistic scaling with salary. The +165 anytime TD prop bet translates to a 37.7% implied probability, aligning with moderate confidence in his touchdown upside.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Jefferson's WR2 projection hinges on Murray's stability; any QB inconsistency propagates directly into receiver variance.

layer2.mapping: Converts thehuddle's WR10 consensus to a GSI posterior mean estimate, while the anytime TD probability maps to a conformal quantile threshold for tournament builds. The GSE state-transition model tracks Murray's Week 1 starter history as a covariate.
layer2.telemetry: Monitor Jefferson's red-zone target share and contested catch percentage against Green Bay's secondary grading (PFN pass defense)

primitives.name: Hurts QB Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Justin Jefferson, WR — $8,100 (single source: thehuddle; DK $7,300) - Projection: consensus WR10 (USA Today), WR2 (FantasyPros primer); +165 anytime TD.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_P_FD_QB_Hurts': 'Expected FanDuel fantasy points per game for Jalen Hurts, dimensionless'}

layer2.telemetry: Record Hurts' rushing attempts per dropback and Washington's explosive play rate against the ground game
